prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production base sprite for an existing 2D MUGEN/anime fighting game, on genuine transparent background. Reference 1 is the existing Samurai pixel style and reference 2 the existing Dio pixel style; neither is an edit target. Reference 3 identifies Goku and his orange/blue costume, not a sheet to copy. Create GOKU in BASE FORM, black spiky hair with the unmistakable large swept pointed locks, athletic muscular anime proportions, determined expressive face with recognizable black eyes, orange gi with navy-blue undershirt, navy sash, blue wristbands and boots, red/tan small boot details. No weapon, no aura, no effects. Full body, facing RIGHT, grounded balanced martial arts stance, ready but relaxed. Near leg on image left and far leg on right, feet apart with both soles on a common horizontal floor; knees slightly bent. Near arm on image left bent with closed fist near lower chest, far arm on right raised with visible closed fist at chest height. Keep fists, forearms, thighs, shins and boots readable and separated enough for an articulated sprite rig. Same level of angular native-pixel contour, clothing folds, solid color clusters and limited shaded palette as Samurai. No smooth illustration, no painterly details, no 3D, no chibi, no geometric stick body. Draw authentic pixel art as if it were a 130-pixel-high game character magnified FOUR TIMES with nearest-neighbor: each logical pixel is a clearly visible square, flat color clusters, 1-logical-pixel dark contour, 3-4 tones per material and roughly 32 colors total. One character only in a square transparent canvas, centered horizontally, ample transparent margin, complete hair and feet in frame. Sprite should occupy approximately half the canvas height (roughly 520px tall on a 1024 square canvas), depicting 130 logical pixels. Do not draw checkerboard, text, labels, scenery, shadows or sprite-sheet frames. Identity and clear anatomy matter more than ornamental detail. This will become the real in-game base; create just one consistent high-quality pose.
